label: GO step choosing a2 late in the episode (trial >= 70), strongest after an unrewarded trial
explanation: Fires only at GO steps (100% of mass), essentially only when the model is choosing a2 (model_act==2 holds 100% of mass; choice logit strongly negative), and only late in the episode: no activity before trial ~58, rising through trials 60-99 (peak 80-89), matching the low-value bins (value < 7.1 holds ~98% of mass). It is strongly modulated by the previous outcome: prev_reward==0 carries 92% of mass and in_rew==1 never co-occurs with activation. Never fires at D1 or D2, nor on a1 choices. The predicate uses only observed variables (phase, the agent own policy argmax, episode position, the reward just seen) and captures ~90% of activation mass with ~0.49 precision on dev; GO+a2+late without the reward condition reaches 98% mass but 0.24 precision. Activity is sparse within the predicate, so the feature looks like an a2-choice / late-episode / unrewarded conjunction whose magnitude grows with episode time; the largest activations are a2 GOs after an unrewarded trial in the final ~30 trials.
